definitions: Public website conversations created in the period, including empty ones. Not unique people.
Non-deleted visitor- or staff-confirmed leads from public website conversations, created in the period. External API leads are excluded.
Conversations created in the period with a visitor message and a confirmed collection by period end, divided by eligible conversations. Each conversation counts once.
Share of conversations created in the period without a completed manual reply or human takeover by period end. This does not measure resolution.
Unique public conversations with a human request or takeover event in the period.
Mean provider-reported generation duration for completed Ollama executions. Not time to first visible reply. Mock and unknown durations excluded.
title: A clearer view of every conversation.
subtitle: Real activity. Measured outcomes. Your team in context.
insights: What is happening in your AI Chat
emptyBody: Choose another period or connect a website. Real activity will appear here.
qualityNote: A context without sources is a retrieval signal, not proof that AI could not answer. Technical failures are separate.
teamNote: Replies belong to their actual author. First response is measured per handoff episode, not by the latest assignee.
usageNote: Current billing period, independent of analytics date filters. Mock is demo usage, never commercial.
error: Analytics could not be loaded. Try again.
insightGrowth: Conversations compared with the previous period
noPrediction: Activity is not proof of a successful consultation.
